MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The clear epoxy felt like a natural next choice because I have bought repair tapes and vinyl cement, and it would give me another way to handle small repairs.",
    "The screw thread gauge appealed to me because identifying replacement screws could help across different repair jobs without requiring a particular project right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fitting, ring terminals, screws, washers and bolts require exact dimensions or connections that my purchases do not establish I need.",
    "The cutting and polishing wheels assume I own compatible tools and have work for them, while the adhesive magnets do not address a current need I recognize.",
    "Packs of a hundred identical fasteners feel unnecessary without a matching project, even though I have bought other supplies in bulk."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any hardware supply, but I choose supplies for a practical use.",
    "Buying hose clamps and electrical connectors seemed to imply that other fittings and connectors would suit me regardless of their size or connection type."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Broad usefulness matters when I do not have a specific repair underway; that is why the gauge and epoxy felt more relevant than narrowly sized parts.",
    "My connector and clamp purchases include assortments or adjustable parts, which leave room for different needs instead of committing me to many identical pieces.",
    "My purchases are spread over time, so an older repair supply does not necessarily describe a project I am still working on."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but too often assumed a specific project, tool or part size that I have not shown I need."
}
